atlas_air_waypoint_export: Terrain waypoint: {east} m east, {north} m north of grid centre.
atlas_air_waypoint_set: Terrain waypoint set. Distance and bearing update as you fly.
atlas_air_waypoint_hint: Tap a ridge on the map to set a course.
atlas_air_waypoint_keyboard: Tap to select a terrain waypoint. Arrow keys move it by 250 metres, or 1 kilometre with Shift. Home selects the central ridge. Delete clears it.
atlas_air_surface_scope: Clearance ≥ 150 m · 75 m elevation grid · illustrated rock and snow
atlas_nebula_nav_export: Interior camera: x {x} ly, y {y} ly, z {z} ly; free travel {travel} ly. Coordinates and depth are illustrative.
atlas_nebula_nav_light: Light would need {n} years to cover your free travel.
atlas_nebula_nav_map: Camera position within the illustrative cloud, seen from above
atlas_nebula_nav_rate_value: {n} light-years per second of camera travel
atlas_nebula_nav_overview_note: Enter the bowl of illuminated gas. Continue in any direction to see dust and stars shift against one another.
atlas_nebula_nav_stars_note: The Trapezium’s bright stars energize the gas with ultraviolet light. Their light points are enlarged; move sideways to discover the depth around them.
atlas_nebula_nav_cavity_note: Radiation and stellar winds have hollowed a bowl-like cavity. Look toward its walls, then move into the denser material.
atlas_nebula_nav_front_note: Ultraviolet light meets dense gas along the glowing front. Follow this boundary and notice how the illuminated folds overlap.
atlas_nebula_nav_dust_note: Dust hides stars and glowing gas farther away. Move around this ridge, or reveal embedded stars to compare the same view with reduced opacity.
atlas_nebula_nav_help: Drag to look. W/A/S/D or arrows move; Q/E change height. Shift boosts travel. Space brakes, R resets, Escape returns outside. Tap a movement button for 0.25 ly, or hold it to travel.
atlas_nebula_nav_scope: Camera travel is accelerated. Depth, star positions and cloud colors are illustrative; the 24 light-year span sets the scale.
atlas_nebula_nav_canvas: Inside Orion. Drag to look. W A S D or arrows move. Q and E change height. Space brakes. R resets. Escape returns to the whole nebula.
